elements.name: Stream finalisation failure is returned to the caller

steps.name: a small new Office package
I write it to a stream that fails during finalisation

elements.name: A serialisation failure preserves an existing destination

steps.name: an existing destination and an unserialisable package
I attempt to save over the destination
saving fails and the destination and package state remain unchanged
no temporary files remain in the destination directory

name: Caller-defined package intake budgets
description: Budget violations are refused before payload allocation or decompression.

elements.name: Finite sufficient budgets permit normal intake
